verdict.rationale: Graphite's AI privacy documentation says its AI features "do not store or train on your data" and that neither Graphite nor its subprocessors use customer data to train models, backed by contractual prohibitions on its Anthropic and OpenAI subprocessors. That means no training happens by default, and organizations can additionally request a complete block of all AI features. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of the no-training commitment, and a self-serve org-wide AI disable control (it currently requires emailing support).
